_doc: Per-company application caps. `max_per_window` applications per rolling `window_days`. Counts only applications actually submitted (any tracker.json entry with an `applied` date). Add a company the moment a posting, portal, or auto-reply email states a limit, and quote it in `source`. Set `confirmed: false` when the number was inferred rather than read verbatim.

default.note: No known cap. Soft guidance only — see soft_cap.

soft_cap.note: Self-imposed ceiling for any company with no published limit. Twenty applications to one employer in a week reads as spray-and-pray to a recruiter even where no rule forbids it. Going over is the user's call, never an automatic skip.

aliases._doc: Lowercased variant -> canonical company name, so 'acme inc' and 'Acme' count against the same cap.

_example.source: Recruiting auto-reply YYYY-MM-DD, verbatim: "...limit of 10 job applications during a 30-day period".
_example.note: Delete this example entry once you add a real one. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
